title: Läpi neekerien maan-osan Henry Stanleyn matkat, seikkailut ja vaarat Afrikassa

As Stanley gathers supplies and recruits companions, he begins to outline his ambitious plans for the expedition, setting the stage for the challenges and adventures that await him and his team as they journey into the heart of Africa.
